learning.note: Every successful refresh settles results and evaluates calibration. Model promotion needs 100 settled games, fresh, non-overlapping dated holdouts and improvement in both Brier score and log loss.

ml.note: 95% Wilson interval describes hit-rate sampling uncertainty, not profit or the probability of an individual pick; games may be correlated. Reliability is conditional on no push.

total.note: 95% Wilson interval describes hit-rate sampling uncertainty, not profit or the probability of an individual pick; games may be correlated. Reliability is conditional on no push.

validation.note: Same settled games: uniform home/away/draw for UCL ML; equal probabilities for two-way markets. Brier is the sum across outcomes; lower Brier and log loss are better. Pushes excluded. These results do not establish a betting edge. Target: 28 settled dates and 100 games per market before review. Demo results are not evidence.
